object.name: Rigel Kentaurus
object.notes: Position from the J2000 component direction and the 750.81 mas Alpha Centauri AB parallax from Akeson et al. (2021). Motion: Akeson et al. (2021) Alpha Centauri AB barycenter solution at J2019.5, shared by A and B; no binary orbital motion. Alpha Centauri A reviewed physical parameters. Akeson et al. (2021) combine the revised orbital parallax with published angular diameter and bolometric flux measurements for the mass, radius, and luminosity. Kervella et al. (2017) derive the effective temperature from interferometry and bolometric flux. Morel (2018) measures [Fe/H] in a differential HARPS abundance analysis. Joyce & Chaboyer (2018) infer the shared system age from classical and asteroseismic constraints.
